description: This file defines session access control logic, including session visibility resolution, agent-to-agent policies, and access guard functions for session keys within the openclaw project.

methods.name: resolveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Resolves the session tools visibility setting from configuration.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Determines effective session tools visibility considering sandboxing.

methods.name: resolveSandboxSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Gets sandbox session tools visibility setting.

methods.name: resolveSandboxedSessionToolContext
methods.description: Creates context for sandboxed session tools, including main key, alias, and visibility.

methods.name: createAgentToAgentPolicy
methods.description: Creates policy object for agent-to-agent communication permissions.

methods.name: createSessionVisibilityGuard
methods.description: Creates a guard function to check session access permissions based on visibility and policies.
